caption: The drawing consists of a single thick, black, arched line that resembles an upside-down "U" shape, with its ends flattened into horizontal bars. Extending upward from the apex of the arch is a straight line, also thick, intersected near its top by a shorter horizontal bar, forming a cross-like shape. On each side of the arch near the bottom, the line curves outward to form hook-like shapes before ending in the horizontal bars. The entire composition is rendered in black on a plain, off-white background, which has some slight discolorations and smudges, especially near the edges. There are no additional colors or objects present in the drawing.
title: Cattle Brand
